servinfo.title: Cooling System Refilling
servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following procedure, observe Precautions for Cooling System:K14C .

s1.ptxt: Fill reservoir (1) with coolant up to “FULL” mark (2).
Fill radiator with coolant up to bottom of radiator filler neck and install radiator cap.
Run engine at idle speed until radiator fan motor is operated.
Stop engine and wait until engine cools down to avoid getting burned.
Add coolant to radiator up to bottom of radiator filler neck, and install radiator cap.
Check that coolant level in reservoir is at “FULL” mark. If coolant is insufficient, add coolant.
